candidate.definition_en: A general vote by the electorate on a single political question.
candidate.explanation_ar: استفتاء شعبي، يعني لما الحكومة تسأل الشعب كله عن رأيهم في موضوع مهم ويصوتوا بنعم أو لا.

senses.definition_en: A general vote by the electorate on a single political question.
senses.definition_ar: استفتاء شعبي؛ تصويت عام يدلي فيه أفراد الشعب برأيهم في مسألة سياسية محددة.
examples: They held a referendum on independence.
The government promised a referendum on the new constitution.
Critics argued the referendum was merely a political maneuver.
They held a referendum on independence.
The government promised a referendum on the new constitution.
Critics argued the referendum was merely a political maneuver.
candidate.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Refer' (يرجع).. الحكومة بترجع للشعب تاخد رأيه في الـ 'Referendum'.
